svg.title: Raspberry Pi Pico + AHT20 + ENS160 wiring diagram
svg.desc: 3V3 OUT pin 36 to all power inputs (VCC/3V3/VDD); GND pin 38 to all GND; GP4 pin 6 to all SDA; GP5 pin 7 to all SCL; GP10 pin 14 to left button OUT; GP11 pin 15 to right button OUT. Includes SSD1306, DS3231, sensors and two touch buttons. ENS160 ADD and CS to 3.3 V; VIN and NT/INT unconnected.
svg.text: Soldering guide · shared I²C bus · 3.3 V module power
Top view · USB at the top
Crossing without a dot = no connection. NC = leave unconnected.
Match the indicated board views and the labels on your own modules.
Use breakout modules rated for a 3.3 V power input, with I²C pull-ups to 3.3 V.
Buttons: momentary mode, OUT = HIGH on touch. Leave unused Pico pins disconnected.
ENS160: ADD + CS → 3V3; VIN + NT/INT → NC. I²C address 0x53.
